body: effort:high - safety floor (rest/gouge verification and stock-scan behaviour), however small the diff; not max: the fix follows the Groove rows' existing Mode::Revolve pattern rather than a new collision law. If the not-yet-root-caused Profile envelope findings (incl. the 0.0073 gouge figure) turn out to be in scope, that part is a new scan-law design and should get its own issue. Labels set by the maintenance lane (effort only); P*/type/area belong to the pick lane (reads bug + P3 by the tables - legal program refused, workaround = no groove cut by Facing). source:agent deliberately not applied - human-filed.

Triage by the AGENTS.md table (per MainSession's standing rule): bug + P3 + area:sim + area:turning; effort:high stands (safety floor on the rest check, existing Mode::Revolve pattern). Not P1: the scan errs REFUSING (over-counting rest) and the post stays blocked - nothing wrong posts; the 0.0073 mm Profile figure is a REPORTED finding, not a passed-through gouge. If work on the Profile half shows a path that posts WITH rest or gouge, that flips this to P1 - say so here before changing the number.

The Profile half, measured on the same shaft (main 38699549), comes from the same hidden-floor reading as the Facing.

The shaft's hidden floor is the groove's lower annulus at z 34 (r 5.5 to 7), under the r 7 roof at z 37. Its far-side rim is (-7, 0, 34). The nearest pass centre in the groove (y = 0, x ≥ 0) sits at the groove floor plus the nose, plus the leave on the rough:

| Op | Nearest centre (x, z) | √((7 + x)² + (z − 34)²) − 0.8 | Reported rest |
|---|---|---|---|
| Profile Finish | (6.3, 34.8) | 12.524 | 12.489 |
| Profile Rough (leave 0.25) | (6.55, 35.05) | 12.791 | 12.7553 |

Both figures sit 0.035 below the prediction, and their difference (0.266) matches the prediction's. A sampling offset of the scan near the rim would explain the 0.035, but that is not checked.

The `0.0073 mm gouge` on Profile Finish is under the 0.05 tolerance. It prints only because the rest convicted: `finish_envelope` (`crates/sim/src/verify/finish.rs`) builds one `Envelope` warning from both numbers when `rep.gouge_mm > gouge_gate || rep.rest_mm > gate`.

On the stepped bar without a groove, Profile Rough and Profile Finish give no findings and post (829 lines with the Facing).

Root cause (likely): the same as the body. No new scan law is needed for the Profile kinds; they meet the same reading. This was not checked against the profile kernel's own path, only against the reported figures.
